Mei-Lin Wu  
📍 Tel Aviv, Israel | 📞 +972-54-123-4567 | 📧 mei-lin.wu@globaltechsolutions.co | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/mei-lin-wu  
QA/Test Engineer with a focus on scalable test automation frameworks, performance optimization, and API validation. Specialized in integrating CI/CD pipelines with test execution, reducing regression cycle times by 30% across distributed systems. Proven ability to design test strategies that align with business objectives, delivering measurable improvements in product reliability.  

At GlobalTech Solutions Inc., I lead end-to-end QA processes for enterprise SaaS platforms, ensuring compliance with SLA metrics. Spearheaded the migration of test environments to cloud-native infrastructure, resulting in a 25% reduction in deployment delays. Developed a Python-based script to automate dependency resolution in microservices, slashing manual effort by 40%. Collaborated with DevOps teams to integrate GitHub Actions into CI pipelines, achieving 95% test coverage for critical modules. My work on performance testing with k6 identified latency bottlenecks in high-traffic scenarios, enabling a 15% improvement in system responsiveness.  

At CloudEdge Corp, I optimized API testing workflows using Selenium and Playwright, reducing flaky test rates by 22% through improved locators and parallel execution. Designed a test strategy for a cloud migration project, aligning test cases with compliance standards and reducing post-release defect density by 35%. Implemented Node.js-based tools to monitor real-time system health during stress tests, providing actionable insights for infrastructure scaling.  

At TechNova Solutions, I automated regression testing for a Java-based enterprise application, achieving 85% coverage with minimal maintenance overhead. Built integration tests for third-party services, ensuring seamless data synchronization across platforms. Introduced JMeter for load testing, identifying scalability issues before production launch and saving an estimated $120k in potential remediation costs.  

Technical Skills:  
- **Go**: Instrumented microservices for observability, implemented custom metrics exporters for distributed tracing.  
- **Integration testing**: Automated cross-system data validation for payment gateways, ensuring 99.9% accuracy in transaction flows.  
- **Java**: Refactored legacy test scripts into modular frameworks, improving maintainability and reducing redundancy.  
- **Node.js**: Developed a CLI tool for test environment provisioning, cutting setup time by 50%.  
- **Performance testing (JMeter/k6)**: Conducted stress tests for high-concurrency scenarios, optimizing backend resource allocation.  
- **Test strategy design**: Defined test scope for a Kubernetes-based platform, aligning with security and compliance mandates.  
- **API testing**: Owned test automation for a RESTful API, achieving 100% coverage and reducing post-deployment defects by 45%.  
- **GitHub Actions**: Orchestration of CI/CD pipelines for 12+ projects, ensuring automated testing on every commit.  
- **Python**: Built data pipelines for test result analysis, enabling real-time dashboards for QA teams.  
- **Selenium/Playwright**: Automated browser-based workflows, improving cross-browser compatibility and user experience.  
- **Test automation**: Reduced manual testing hours by 60% through custom framework development and script reusability.
